$schema.description: JSON schema to validate this file

highAltitude.description: Maximum altitude for interpolation in feet

lowPrecision.description: Precision at low altitude in NM

highPrecision.description: Precision at high altitude in NM

rdf.description: Radio Direction Finder configuration. If not present, RDF will be disabled

color.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)
RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

fontWeight.description: NOT HONOURED here: route labels draw through the screen-text path, which carries no per-label weight yet. Honoured on a layer textStyle.

anchor.description: NOT HONOURED. Labels are positioned by offset alone.

baseline.description: NOT HONOURED. Labels are positioned by offset alone.

lineHeight.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

align.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

wordWrap.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

wordWrapWidth.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

outlineColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

dropShadowColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a) NOT HONOURED.

scaleWithZoom.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Map labels are a constant screen size by design, and the per-size glyph atlases depend on that; zoom-scaled text would need an SDF path.

minZoom.description: NOT HONOURED. Zoom gating is per layer, not per text style.

maxZoom.description: NOT HONOURED. Zoom gating is per layer, not per text style.

backgroundColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

backgroundOpacity.description: NOT HONOURED: labels have no background plate.

size.description: Size of the point in cartesian units

sprite.description: Name of the sprite defined in the sprite atlas

fillColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

strokeColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

rotation.description: Rotation of the symbol in degrees

pointStyle.description: Style of the waypoints along the route

inactiveSectorBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the inactive sector, this is the default color of the map

activeSectorBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the user's current active sector

areaOfInterestBackgroundColor.description: Background color of the area of interest, which is around 15% larger than the user's active sector. This is optional and you do not have to display this

neighborSectorBorderLineWidth.description: Line width of the neighbor sector border, this is the line that separates your sector from another active neighbor sectors

lengthNm.description: Length of the extended centerline in nautical miles

thresholdOffsetNm.description: Offset of the extended centerline from the threshold in nautical miles

minorTickSpacingNm.description: Spacing between minor ticks in nautical miles

minorTickLengthNm.description: Length of the minor tick in nautical miles, this does not apply to circle ticks

minorTickWidth.description: Line width of the major tick, or the radius of the circle in arbitrary units

minorTickColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

majorTickSpacingNm.description: Spacing between major ticks in nautical miles

majorTickLengthNm.description: Length of the major tick in nautical miles, this does not apply to circle ticks

majorTickWidth.description: Line width of the major tick, or the radius of the circle

majorTickColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

headingTool.description: Styling for the heading tools: double-click a target for a straight line, or drag a tag item with a leftDrag of headingPrediction for the turn the aircraft would actually fly. Anything left out falls back to distanceMeasurementTool, then to the aircraft's own speed vector colour.

lineColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

textColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

dashArray.description: Dash and gap in logical pixels, e.g. [12, 6]. Prediction tool only; the straight heading line is always solid.

stcaPairLine.description: A line joining the two aircraft of a short term conflict alert while it stands, drawn under the target symbols. Absent draws none; an empty object draws a solid red line one logical pixel wide. It follows the alert board, so safetyNets.show hiding stca removes it, and it draws only between two aircraft this view draws a symbol for. TopSky has no such line.

color.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a). Red when absent.

lineWidth.description: Line width in logical pixels, 1 when absent.

dashArray.description: Dash and gap in logical pixels, e.g. [6, 4]. Absent is solid.

flightPlanSeparationTool.description: FPLSEP, TopSky's predicted minimum separation along the planned routes: a line from each aircraft to where it will be at the minimum, and the minimum and the time to it beside them. Absent, and every key absent, draws in TopSky's FPLSEP orange (255, 170, 46) so the tool is told apart from RADARSEP, which takes the distanceMeasurementTool colours.

lineColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a). FPLSEP orange when absent.

textColour.description: The label's colour, the line colour when absent.

lineWidth.description: Line width in logical pixels, 1 when absent.

tctLeg.description: The TCT legs: both predicted paths to the closest point, plain to the conflict start and embellished beyond, and a label on the other aircraft's leg placed and filled as TopSky's TCT_Label_* settings. Absent draws TopSky's colours and layout.

colour.description: Up to the conflict start. TopSky's (220, 214, 20) when absent.

embellishedColour.description: From the conflict start to the closest point. TopSky's (254, 102, 39) when absent.

labelColour.description: The minimum and the time to it. TopSky's (220, 214, 20) when absent.

lineWidth.description: Line width in logical pixels, 2 when absent.

embellished.description: Draw the conflict part of the leg in embellishedColour, TopSky's TCT_Leg_Embellished.

labelAnchor.description: Where on the other aircraft's leg the label hangs: the start of the conflict (TopSky's default) or the closest point.

labelAngleDeg.description: Direction of the label from the anchor, degrees clockwise from the leg's direction there, TopSky's TCT_Label_Pos_Angle.

labelDistancePx.description: Distance of the label's centre from the anchor, TopSky's TCT_Label_Pos_Distance.

labelData.description: Which point the distance and time describe, TopSky's TCT_Label_Data_Ref.

labelDistance.description: The distance's place beside the time, TopSky's TCT_Label_Distance.

blindSpot.description: The Blind Spot bars in the CFL, heading and direct-to menus. A colour named here wins over the theme's Action.BlindSpot token for this system; absent uses the theme (TopSky's values).

conflictColour.description: A conflict starting within the window.

crossedLevelColour.description: Clear, but a conflicting level lies between it and the present one.

unknownColour.description: The probe could not judge it.

agedColour.description: Every bar once the probe is older than blindSpot.agedS.

startCircleColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

endCircleColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

dashedLineColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

distanceTextColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

startBearingTextColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

endBearingTextColour.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

dashArray.description: Dash, gap, dash, gap and so on, in logical pixels: an even number of values, repeated along the line. An odd count repeats with dashes and gaps swapped; a value of 0 or less draws solid

type.description: The built-in symbol, a sprite, or shape for the shape named by shape.

shape.description: With type shape: the name of a shape in systems/shapes.json, drawn at each point in its own colours and design units, growing with the display scale. A feature's own symbol is drawn in its place.

color.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a) NOT HONOURED here: a map label takes its point's own colour at full alpha. Set the point colour instead.

fontFamily.description: NOT HONOURED here: map labels are rasterised in the renderer-wide font family.

fontWeight.description: Coarse stroke weight, applied as a coverage threshold shift so no second atlas is needed. Overridden by textWeight when both are set.

textWeight.description: Fine stroke weight. Negative thins the strokes, positive thickens them, 0 is the font's own weight. Overrides fontWeight.

textSharpness.description: Edge hardness. 0 keeps the rasteriser's own antialiasing, 1 gives a near-binary edge. A negative textWeight with some sharpness gives a thin, crisp look.

anchor.description: NOT HONOURED. Labels are positioned by offset alone.

baseline.description: NOT HONOURED. Labels are positioned by offset alone.

lineHeight.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

align.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

wordWrap.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

wordWrapWidth.description: NOT HONOURED. Map labels are single-line.

outlineColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a) NOT HONOURED here. Text outlines are supported on routeDraw.textStyle only.

outlineWidth.description: NOT HONOURED here. Text outlines are supported on routeDraw.textStyle only.

outlineOpacity.description: NOT HONOURED here. Text outlines are supported on routeDraw.textStyle only.

dropShadowColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a) NOT HONOURED.

scaleWithZoom.description: NOT SUPPORTED. Map labels are a constant screen size by design, and the per-size glyph atlases depend on that; zoom-scaled text would need an SDF path.

minZoom.description: NOT HONOURED. Zoom gating is per layer, not per text style.

maxZoom.description: NOT HONOURED. Zoom gating is per layer, not per text style.

backgroundColor.description: RGBA color array [r,g,b,a] or [r,g,b] (0-255, and 0-1 for a)

backgroundOpacity.description: NOT HONOURED: labels have no background plate.

geodesic.description: Whether a long oblique segment is drawn as the great circle between its ends instead of the straight Mercator chord. Default true. Segments under 20 km and segments whose ends share a latitude (a parallel) are always straight. Overridable per feature with a top-level geodesic property. The server projects sector volumes with the same rule.

layerStyles.description: Layer styles for the map, this is a dictionary of layer names to layer styles, and overrides the default values in the manifest for the layer
